title: The Syrophoenician Woman and Her Daughter
description: A Greek woman of Syrophoenician descent comes to Jesus in the region of Tyre and asks him to drive an unclean spirit out of her little daughter. Jesus replies that the children must be fed first, and that it is not right to take the children's bread and throw it to the small dogs. The woman answers that even the dogs under the table eat the crumbs from the children's plates. Because of this reply, Jesus heals her daughter, and when the woman returns home, she finds her child well.
